header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
body: Mr. Ghulam Abbas Dalwani, A.P.G = None is present on behalf of the petitioner. Learned A.P.G submits that the interim challan of the F.I.R in question has been submitted before the court having jurisdiction.
Since no one is in attendance on behalf of the petitioner, therefore this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
